direct_sum.label: l=(address,sign)
direct_sum.reason: The label blocks are disjoint and every T_{A(l)} is a permutation, so F is a permutation and its linear extension is unitary.
direct_sum.phase_reason: X, CX, and MCX are computational-basis permutations with no branch-dependent phase.

load_use_unload.inverse_unload_condition: The label and payload remain unchanged, all payload-dependent work is zero, and L^dagger is the reversed forward qROM gate list.

exception_mask_transport.cleanup: Compute e_l^out directly into temporary work, XOR it into E, then uncompute the temporary work; E becomes zero.
exception_mask_transport.forbidden_cleanup_shortcut: Do not retain an unaccounted R_in copy and do not execute T^{-1} followed by a second T merely to erase E.

liveness.payload: from completion of stage [0,1) through start of stage [6,7)
liveness.exception_mask: from copy during [1,2) through XOR cleanup during [5,6)

gate_accounting.x_count: N_X=2x_Q+x_C_in+x_S_ctl+x_G+x_E_mux+x_C_out+2*sum_J I_J, where I_J counts maximal negative-polarity conjugation intervals
gate_accounting.negative_control_no_sharing_case: I_J=sum over controlled gates of the number of negative control literals
gate_accounting.non_derivability_reason: The two scientific inputs do not instantiate the symbolic component vectors.

width_functions.q_c_q_d: clean and dirty qROM scratch peaks
width_functions.c_in_c_out_d_in_d_out: clean and dirty input/output comparator scratch peaks
width_functions.a_G_c_a_G_d: clean and dirty generic arithmetic work
width_functions.a_E_c_a_E_d: clean and dirty exceptional arithmetic work
width_functions.m_E_c_m_E_d: clean and dirty exceptional mux work
width_functions.h_c_h_d: clean and dirty realization work for the fixed MCX18 layer

ancilla_accounting.clean_peak: max(p+q_c, p+b+c_in, p+b+u_c, p+b+u_c+max(a_G_c,a_E_c+m_E_c)+h_c, p+b+c_out, p+q_c)
ancilla_accounting.dirty_peak: max(q_d, d_in, u_d, u_d+max(a_G_d,a_E_d+m_E_d)+h_d, d_out, q_d)
ancilla_accounting.stagewise_total_rule: Add clean and dirty live widths at each stage after legal register reuse, then take the maximum.

hidden_n_bit_register_condition.base_assumption: Three accounted n-bit banks plus logarithmic label/control storage
hidden_n_bit_register_condition.necessary_and_sufficient_condition: The maximum live width not colorable into the three accounted banks is O(log n) for the chosen w=w(n).
hidden_n_bit_register_condition.payload_condition: Any Theta(n) payload must reuse an accounted bank; otherwise p adds a hidden n-bit bank.
hidden_n_bit_register_condition.exception_cleanup_condition: The transported output predicate must be computable in place or by streaming with O(log n) extra work; retaining R_in adds a hidden n-bit bank.
hidden_n_bit_register_condition.mux_condition: Generic and exceptional Theta(n) candidates must not coexist outside the three accounted banks.
hidden_n_bit_register_condition.qrom_condition: The inverse unload reuses the forward payload register and allocates no second payload buffer.
hidden_n_bit_register_condition.sufficient_scaling_example: Every unallocated stage width is O(w+log n) with w=O(log n), or every larger width is explicitly reused within the three accounted banks.

claim_boundary: Abstract direct-sum derivation, aliases, reversible cleanup, symbolic counts, and scalable width condition only.
